# CJSModels

Fit first-capture-conditional Cormack-Jolly-Seber models in R using
native TMB. Estimate unit-time apparent survival and detection from
encounter histories.

> **Experimental software.** Results are provisional. Development tests
> do not establish parameter recovery, interval coverage or scientific
> maturity. Apparent survival combines mortality and permanent
> emigration.

## Start with a fixed-effects model

Read the [worked
example](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/articles/cjs-first-capture.md),
then the [data
constructor](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/cmr_data.md)
and [fitting
function](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/drm_cjs.md).
Install from GitHub with
`remotes::install_github("itchyshin/CJSModels")`, or from a reviewed
local source checkout with `R CMD INSTALL .`; TMB and a C++ compiler are
required. No CRAN release is claimed.

The likelihood conditions on each animal’s first capture. It excludes
all-zero histories and does not estimate abundance or unseen animals.

## Tested scope

See the [tested scope
article](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/articles/tested-scope.md)
for check results, route qualifications and deferred work.

## Julia companion

Read the [Julia companion
documentation](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels.jl/).

[CJSModels.jl](https://github.com/itchyshin/CJSModels.jl) provides a
standalone Julia API. The optional R bridge uses a separate Julia
environment containing CJSModels and RCall; RCall is not a dependency of
the standalone Julia package. See [bridge
setup](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/cjs_julia_setup.md)
for the R entry point. Public development source is available on GitHub.
The software remains experimental.

# Package index

## Prepare and fit CJS data

- [`cmr_data()`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/cmr_data.md)
  : Validate and store capture histories for conditional CJS models
- [`drm_cjs()`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/drm_cjs.md)
  : Fit a first-capture-conditional CJS model

## Predictions and inference

- [`predict(`*`<drm_cjs>`*`)`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/predict.drm_cjs.md)
  : Predict process-specific quantities from a conditional CJS fit
- [`simulate(`*`<drm_cjs>`*`)`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/simulate.drm_cjs.md)
  : Simulate conditional capture histories from a CJS fit
- [`coef(`*`<drm_cjs>`*`)`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/coef.drm_cjs.md)
  : Coefficients from a conditional CJS fit
- [`logLik(`*`<drm_cjs>`*`)`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/logLik.drm_cjs.md)
  : Log likelihood for a conditional CJS fit
- [`vcov(`*`<drm_cjs>`*`)`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/vcov.drm_cjs.md)
  : Covariance matrix for a conditional CJS fit
- [`confint(`*`<drm_cjs>`*`)`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/confint.drm_cjs.md)
  : Wald, profile, or parametric-bootstrap intervals for a conditional
  CJS fit

## Optional Julia bridge

- [`cjs_julia_setup()`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/cjs_julia_setup.md)
  : Connect the optional standalone Julia twin

## Package

- [`CJSModels`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/CJSModels-package.md)
  [`CJSModels-package`](https://itchyshin.github.io/CJSModels/reference/CJSModels-package.md)
  : CJSModels: first-capture-conditional capture-mark-recapture
